proposal.summary: A vulnerability in the DMG file parser of ClamAV (certain versions) enables XML external entity injection via enabled XML entity substitution, allowing an unauthenticated remote attacker who submits a crafted DMG file for scanning to leak bytes from files readable by the ClamAV scanning process.
proposal.affected_product: ClamAV versions 1.0.0 and earlier, 0.105.1 and earlier, and 0.103.7 and earlier

AV.quote: An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by submitting a crafted DMG file to be scanned by ClamAV on an affected device.

AC.quote: An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by submitting a crafted DMG file to be scanned by ClamAV on an affected device.

PR.quote: An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by submitting a crafted DMG file to be scanned by ClamAV on an affected device.

UI.quote: An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by submitting a crafted DMG file to be scanned by ClamAV on an affected device.

S.quote: A successful exploit could allow the attacker to leak bytes from any file that may be read by the ClamAV scanning process.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Confirm affected component and versions, reproduce by submitting a crafted DMG to a test instance, and determine exact impact and exploitability (e.g., files readable by the scanning process).

evidence_quotes.quote: A vulnerability in the DMG file parser of ClamAV versions 1.0.0 and earlier, 0.105.1 and earlier, and 0.103.7 and earlier could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access sensitive information on an affected device.
This vulnerability is due to enabling XML entity substitution that may result in XML external entity injection.
